name: Soft almond
logic: A calm, continuous almond with softened joins. The original eight dot iris remains the clearest link to the company.
caution: The closest evolution of the supplied mark. Fine dots need a small size check.

name: Pill lens
logic: A capsule turns the familiar button pill into an eye. Straight upper and lower spans make the mark compact and steady.
caution: Strong family resemblance to the controls. Can read as a switch without the iris.

name: Soft rectangle
logic: A continuous rounded enclosure gives the eye a device like frame while retaining a living iris.
caution: More architectural than organic. Avoid letting the outline resemble a camera housing.

name: Open lids
logic: Two separate arcs leave the corners open, suggesting a relaxed blink rather than an enclosing shield.
caution: Airy and responsive. Open corners may weaken the silhouette at small sizes.

name: Sculpted lens
logic: A heavier upper lid and a quiet lower curve create a filled, sculptural eye with a clear aperture.
caution: A stronger app icon shape. The weighted upper lid needs balance beside Comfortaa.

name: Ellipse orbit
logic: An elliptical eye emphasizes continuous observation and a generous aperture without sharp corners.
caution: Soft and simple, with less explicit eye character than the almond.

name: Lens brackets
logic: Two curved brackets frame the iris. The missing top and bottom strokes make the eye feel open and light.
caution: Distinct and spacious. Brackets can imply scanning rather than comfort.

name: Resting blink
logic: A shallow eye and low iris describe a relaxed eyelid with less vertical occupation.
caution: Efficient in a menu bar. The compressed eye can look sleepy.

name: Paired gaze
logic: Two separate eyes distribute the company’s eight circles equally across both sides, making bilateral movement part of the identity.
caution: Directly expresses two eyes. Both small irises compete for limited menu bar pixels.

name: Living seed
logic: An asymmetric upper lid suggests movement while the iris holds a stable central anchor.
caution: Memorable organic tension. It must remain neutral rather than suggest unequal eye health.

name: Round aperture
logic: A circular outer frame contains a simple eye cut and the eight circle iris, joining observation with a focus dial.
caution: Robust circular icon, with a risk of unnecessary nested boundaries.

name: Petal iris
logic: Eight rounded radial strokes reinterpret the company’s circles as a soft iris inside the eye.
caution: More legible strokes at small sizes. It can resemble a loading spinner if animated continuously.

name: Forward gaze
logic: The iris moves gently to one side inside a generous almond, suggesting attention shifting beyond the screen.
caution: A clear eye with directional character. The resting logo should not appear to watch a particular person.

name: Ribbon fold
logic: A pair of offset lid ribbons shares rounded endings with the pill controls. The iris sits in their open overlap.
caution: Dynamic without arrows. Heavy terminals can crowd the iris.

name: Constellation eye
logic: Eight dots form the eye boundary itself, letting the company motif become the whole silhouette. A pupil makes the eye reading explicit.
caution: The strongest departure from a conventional eye icon. Sparse dots need careful spacing at 16 pixels.
